# `gen.lathe`: Lathe

Revolves a profile around an axis into a round object with groups side, cap_top, cap_bottom and profile_<i>.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(profile points x segments + segments^2) for quad-grid caps
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: lathe, spin, screw, revolve, surface of revolution, turn

The best tool for round objects: barrels, vases, bottles, bowls, columns, wheels, knobs, lamp bases.

**Profile:** a preset (`barrel`, `vase`, `bottle`, `bowl`, `column`, scaled by `height` and `radius`), points `[radius, height]` in meters (`smooth: true` for a curve through them), or `{"curve": "name"}` for a curve object drawn in its XY plane (x is the radius). Points may run up or down; faces always point out of the solid. Only the ends of an open profile may touch the axis (they close as poles). `closed: true` makes rings (tires, washers).

**Groups:** `side` (all revolved faces), `profile_<i>` per profile span from the bottom (loop cuts, hoops, materials), `cap_top` and `cap_bottom` for filled ends. Cap rims and profile corners sharper than 30 degrees get sharp edges.

**Caps** are `quad_grid` by default (needs a multiple of 4 segments), `ngon`, `fan` or `none`. Segments adapt to the largest radius and the asset class when omitted.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | `Angle` | `360.0` | Revolution (degrees); partial turns start at the front and stay open. |
| `axis` | `AxisParam` | `"y"` | Axis to revolve around; the profile's height runs along it. |
| `cap` | `CapParam` | `"quad_grid"` | How the open ends of a full turn are filled. |
| `closed` | `boolean` | `false` | Joins the last point back to the first (rings such as tires and washers; points only). |
| `height` | `Length \| null` | - | Height of a preset profile (presets only). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; a free name such as `lathe_1` is picked when omitted. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length] \| null` | - | Origin position in the parent's space. Built from a curve object, the result takes the curve's place (parent and transform) unless `parent` or `position` is given. |
| `profile` | `Profile` | required | The profile to revolve. |
| `radius` | `Length \| null` | - | Largest radius of a preset profile (presets only). |
| `resolution` | `number` | `6` | Segments per curved span of a smooth profile. |
| `segments` | `number \| null` | - | Segments around the axis; adapts to the size and asset class when omitted. |
| `smooth` | `boolean` | `false` | A smooth Bezier through the points instead of straight segments (points and polyline curves). |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"barrel","profile":"barrel","segments":24}
```

Result: `created barrel (o:4) lathe 0.62 x 0.9 x 0.62 m: 504 faces (1,008 tris; budget 6,000)`

```json
{"name":"knob","profile":[[0.02,0],[0.03,0.01],[0.025,0.03],[0,0.035]],"segments":16,"smooth":true}
```

Result: `created knob (o:4) lathe 61.25 x 35 x 61.25 mm: 336 faces (656 tris; budget 6,000)`
